music._about: RETIRED in v2 (Omarie, 6 Oct): no synth or library music. lib/music.py is gone; the bed is the in-car stereo and exhaust from the clips themselves (config `bed`). The NO MUSIC master swaps every in-car song for road/exhaust nat (bed segs `sub`).

trims._about: per-piece edge trims (s, source) found on the audio envelope where a neighbouring word crosses the EDL edge (build notes in cue.md)

duck._about: bed sidechain: every dialog piece; raised-cosine attack before the words and release after them; gaps under `bridge` s are held down (no pumping between sentences). Bed music ducks bed.duckDb.music, exhaust and nat duck audio.natDuckDb

audio._aboutDialogFilter: fix B (Omarie, 6 Oct): high-pass 90 Hz, gentle FFT noise reduction (nr 10 dB), -2 dB at 300 Hz, +2.5 dB at 3.5 kHz, de-esser, 3:1 compressor; then each piece is levelled to dialogLufs. dialogFilterPart1 is the old chain (kept for the before/after numbers). edgeFadeOut: the voice fades over 100 ms at the end of its >= 350 ms tail (fix A).

bed._about: v2 (Omarie, 6 Oct): the bed is the in-car stereo nat and exhaust from the clips (paths.aud), no synth or library music. Each seg: source span a-b of clip src placed at timeline t, levelled to its lufs (else the kind default), faded fin/fout (s). Every transcribed word inside a seg (the day index) is muted with 40 ms ramps, so no speech rides in the bed; `mute` adds spans. Music ducks duckDb.music under dialog, exhaust and nat duck audio.natDuckDb. The NO MUSIC master replaces each music seg by its `sub` (the same length of road/exhaust nat from a speech-free, music-free span; no song recognised by Shazam in 10 s windows every 5 s and no drums in htdemucs). Songs are listed in exports/qa/in_car_tracks_part2.md (tools/track_list.py). Forbidden spans apply to bed audio too.
